evidence: Library shows 6 templates each with title, author (e.g. Sarah Chen), and description text.
Each card shows title, author, description, category badge, scenario badge, usage count (e.g. "1,250 uses"), and update date (e.g. "Updated 2024-12-01").
Clicking Use Template opens a dialog with template details (title, category, scenario, description, author, uses) and a Fill Template form tab plus disabled Preview Result tab.
Dialog shows banner "Required fields missing" listing all missing required field names, and Preview Result tab is disabled until filled.
All 14 fields (required and optional) accepted typed values, values persisted in each textbox.
Preview Result tab shows generated resume with all entered values substituted (name, title, email, phone, summary, experience, education, skills).

Markdown Resume template preview renders proper headings (h1/h2/h3), emphasis (italic date range), strong text, and a separator line; all placeholders replaced with entered values, none left unresolved.
Preview Result tab was disabled and showed 'Required fields missing' banner until all required fields had values; became enabled only after full valid completion.
Markdown template rendered proper Markdown formatting (headings, emphasis, separator) after field substitution.
Clicking Copy to Clipboard shows toast "Copied to clipboard! The generated content has been copied."

issue: No format validation on declared-format fields
actual: Entering "not-an-email" into the Email field (declared email format) produced no validation error, and the Preview Result tab remained enabled, generating a preview containing the literal invalid string "not-an-email" instead of rejecting it or blocking the preview.

evidence: Typing "Res" showed real-time suggestions (Professional Resume, Responsibilities, In Progress, Academic Research Summary, Research Title). Clicking "Professional Resume" filled the search box and narrowed results from 6 to 1 matching template.

actual: Typing "Metting" (typo for Meeting) and "Propsal" (typo for Proposal) both returned "0 of 6 templates" with a "No templates found" message and no suggestion dropdown, instead of matching or suggesting the intended template.

evidence: Category filter (Resume) narrowed to 1/6; Scenario filter (Academic) narrowed to 1/6; Sort By Most Popular showed descending use counts (1250,1100,890,720,560,340); Alphabetical sort correctly reordered to Academic, Meeting, Professional Email, Professional Resume, Project Proposal, Weekly Status Report.
All filter/sort/search changes updated the "Showing X of 6 templates" count and card order instantly without any page reload.

Clicking the star icon on Professional Resume and Professional Email added them to favorites (header count updated 0→1→2). Clicking Favorites button opened a favorites-only view showing exactly those 2 templates.
Within Favorites-only view, searching "Resume" narrowed 2→1 favorited templates; applying Category=Email filter narrowed 2→1 matching favorited template.
Clicking the favorite star button immediately updated the header "Favorites" count badge (0→1→2) and the favorites list content, with no reload required.

Submit Template dialog accepted title, author, description, category, scenario, Markdown content with {{title}}/{{name}} placeholders, and two defined fields (title, name) mapped to those placeholders.
Clicking Submit Template with all fields blank showed toast "Missing required fields - Please fill in all required fields." and did not submit; dialog remained open.

Defined fields "title" and "name" mapped exactly to content placeholders {{title}} and {{name}}; submission succeeded and later preview substituted both without unresolved placeholders (see FT-6 evidence).
Two independently defined fields (title, name) were each fillable and retained separate values/placeholders; no duplicate labels tested but distinct fields worked independently without collision.

Immediately after submitting, toast "Template submitted! Your template has been added to the library." appeared and the library count updated from "Showing 6 of 6" to "Showing 7 of 7" with the new "QA Test Template" card visible, with no page reload.

New "QA Test Template" card appeared in library, was selectable via Use Template, form showed defined fields (title, name), and preview correctly substituted both values ("My Custom Title" heading, "Hello Timothee, welcome!" paragraph) with no unresolved placeholders.

Entering "# Injected Heading **bold** <script>alert(1)</script> | table | break" into a field triggered inline error "Special characters like < > { } [ ] \ | ` are not allowed" and disabled the Preview Result tab. Removing the special characters cleared the error and re-enabled Preview.
After navigating/reloading the app, the Favorites count still showed "1" and the custom "QA Test Template" remained in the library (Showing 7 of 7 templates), confirming persistence across reload.
